scope: Native UI draw capture/replay compatibility changes R1, R2 and the R3 initialization follow-up; canonical Lua cadence retained
implementation: Validate and replay native coloroffset, champion, dogma and gold Sprite shaders with their supported vertex layouts and Transform/Texture0 uniform contract.

Seal deferred caller-written vertices before format changes; replay supported image vertex formats in order and restore recorded image fields under a valid texture-generation contract. This is not arbitrary GPU sampler-state replay.
Seal before texture deletion; allow unrelated texture deletion and native nonexistent-name no-ops while rejecting captured-image and framebuffer dependencies.
Validate texture IDs and deletion generations, shader program/descriptor generations, and render context before replay; preserve native resource references and fresh frame depth.
Preserve GL deletion dispatch chains, immediately re-arm a lazy resolver before a second deletion, and conservatively invalidate on foreign-thread or unknown context deletion.

Permit only audited native texture parameter/base-level byte-upload initialization on a known current-unit texture with no captured/target dependency; same-value parameters are no-ops, other changes advance resource generations.

abi.execution: x86 Windows binary via WSL interop
checks: Actual NativeBackend shader/layout selection and extra-uniform rejection
Shader program and descriptor generation changes
Ordered shared-image formats, deferred vertex attributes, final state, and failed-submit resource restoration
Native reference acquisition/release and thiscall/fastcall/stdcall observer ABI
Texture delete: unrelated, current quad, native render target, color framebuffer attachment, invalid arguments, zero and nonexistent names
Primary/palette same-name texture generation reuse and foreign-thread epoch
Two deletions through a lazy resolver preserve the original target and both reach the observer
Canonical main callback, empty scopes, epoch invalidation, foreign-thread and non-render forwarding

Audited native initialization: executable three/nine-argument call-site ABI stubs, bound-unit texture identity, same-value parameters, supported base-level uploads, dependency/FBO/unknown rejection and lazy dispatch targets

regret_r2_runtime_diagnostics.comparison: R1 first load at frame 46 rejected the whole main scope for glDeleteTextures and missed two presentations; R2 observes both unrelated deletions without a scope rejection.
regret_r2_runtime_diagnostics.visual_verification: Separate image comparison owned by another reviewer; diagnostic success alone does not prove rendered pixels.
regret_r2_runtime_diagnostics.source_revision_scope: Historical R2; source hashes are in historical_R2_source_sha256. This is not a runtime test of the later R3 initialization follow-up or a combined lifecycle candidate.

readiness.assessment: R3 standalone core/ABI checks pass; the historical R2 runtime result remains valid for that hash only. Final combined-build startup, feature and lifecycle runtime checks are separate acceptance gates.

limits: Not a claim of compatibility with every enabled mod or arbitrary native GL extension.

Unknown uniforms, unsupported draws, uploads outside the audited initialization path and unexpressed render-target/GL mutations still reject a capture rather than rerun Lua. Arbitrary sampler-state replay is not supported.
Texture deletion tracking covers the checked engine dispatch; arbitrary external GL pointers are outside this verified coverage.
Shader reflection remains uncached; tested GoodTrip workload showed a small measured per-frame cost, not a guarantee for every HUD.
Unit tests and diagnostic counters do not replace actual feature UI images, motion, interaction or physical VRR validation.

bethany_R2_startup_diagnostic.interpretation: First Sprite image loading inside player render; R3 support is restricted to audited native initialization calls. Visibility and final-build acceptance require separate evidence.
